REFERENCE ROLES:

Reference 2 determines the distinctly pixelated art language, pixel cluster size, pixel outlines, face outline/jaw/cheeks/chin and facial feature treatment. MATCH those visibly. Do NOT copy reference 2's gray clothing or messy curled bangs.

- her full adult feminine figure, same relaxed standing posture and same front three-quarter left view. Hands hanging naturally, knees soft. No larger head, no chibi proportion change, no different leg pose.

Face outline, eyes, nose and mouth should feel like reference 2, with deliberately designed small blocks, not a smooth painted face pasted into a pixel body. Keep the face pretty, readable and friendly, not a broad rectangular jaw or baby face.

Hair, face, arms, blouse, shorts and boots ALL share the same obvious pixel size. Remove tiny noisy colored specks, smooth gradients, fractional anti-aliasing and glossy highlights. scope: Static character only: reference-sized pixel clusters and rounded compact face; preserve v38 hair design, cream-yellow blouse, indigo shorts and berry bow. No walking/pet replacement.

acceptance: Candidate based on user-supplied pixel and facial reference; pending user visual acceptance.
